name: Texel Allocation via Rate-Distortion
aliases: Atlas Baking, Bake and Texel Allocation, Stage 2
definition: A stage with no training that bakes the trained hash grid and MLP into a texture atlas and allocates texels per surfel based on rate-distortion.
summary: Texel Allocation via Rate-Distortion optimizes texture atlas size by allocating texels per surfel based on visual importance and distortion, rather than uniform sizing or geometric packing.
